description: A floor-length deep plum gown with an opaque square neckline, shaped bodice, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold woven borders along the neckline, vertical front edges, cuffs and hem. Round ornamental clasps sit on the shoulders and a decorated belt with a broad round buckle marks the waist. A cream patterned shoulder wrap with gold edging rests loosely around the forearms. A cream underdress shows through the front walking opening, and plum slippers are visible at the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
